# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 6 tokens; Text — 6 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 1 token; Borders and rings — 3 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 33 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 15 tokens; Radius — 2 tokens; Shadow — 1 token.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
color: #fafafa;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
color: var(--surface-page);
```

### Tokens (6)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `surface-page` | #fafafa | Page background of documents and slides. |
| `surface-paper` | #ffffff | Paper white where a page sits on a tinted ground. |
| `surface-card` | #f3f3f3 | Flat card and band tint: FeatureCard, PriceCard, Stat bands, Tag light. |
| `surface-card-accent` | #e9e7f2 | Lavender card: the lead service FeatureCard, the PriceCard savings bar. |
| `surface-inverse` | #141414 | Black legal bar, dark Button, near-black ground for the inverse logo. |
| `surface-chip` | #050505 | Ground of the dark Tag. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 700 72px/1.05 "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.035em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-hero); letter-spacing: -0.035em;
font-family: var(--font-display);   /* the family alone */
```

### Font files

Fonts: `tokens.css` loads each font from its file, by path.

- **Design canvas:** copy `fonts/Inter-normal.woff2`, `fonts/Inter-italic.woff2`, `fonts/PlusJakartaSans-normal.woff2` and `fonts/PlusJakartaSans-italic.woff2` to the same paths under the canvas’s `project/ds/<folder>/` (`<folder>` is the folder you install this system under; `fonts/Inter-normal.woff2` lands on `project/ds/<folder>/fonts/Inter-normal.woff2`), in the same call that installs this system; the copy of `tokens.css` that each artboard links loads them from there. If the install’s reply leaves a font out, bring that font in as for any other page.
- **Slides deck:** for each family you use in the deck (`faces` holds at most the number of typefaces Slides’ `deck-files.md` gives), install its file with the system and name the path it lands on as that family’s `src` in `project/deck.json` `faces`, under the key in the Slides column. A deck takes a font as a file only under the rule in Slides’ `fonts.md` (no space or leading underscore in its path, for two): any other font, or one kept by id, is uploaded as `fonts.md` says.
- **Any other page:** one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says (Artifact tool `read`, that id or path as `path`), upload it as an asset (`publish`, `file_path`, `asset:true`) and declare it with an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule.

`tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that links it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

| family | file | fetch | CSS | Slides `faces` key |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Inter | `fonts/Inter-normal.woff2` (weight 300 800) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-text)` | `inter` |
| Plus Jakarta Sans | `fonts/PlusJakartaSans-normal.woff2` (weight 300 800) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-display)` | `plus-jakarta-sans` |

Every face: `fonts/Inter-normal.woff2` (Inter, 300 800), `fonts/Inter-italic.woff2` (Inter, 300 800, italic), `fonts/PlusJakartaSans-normal.woff2` (Plus Jakarta Sans, 300 800), `fonts/PlusJakartaSans-italic.woff2` (Plus Jakarta Sans, 300 800, italic).

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */

/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */

```
